entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Preference falsification is the act of misrepresenting a preference under perceived public pressure. It involves publicly expressing a preference that differs from one's underlying privately held preference. People frequently convey to each other preferences that differ from what they would communicate privately under credible cover of anonymity. Techniques such as list experiments can be used to uncover preference falsification.
